Roster Evolution Analyzer

How trades, acquisitions and player absences shape fantasy-team performance.

What is the Roster Evolution Analyzer?

Fantasy football standings tell us what a team has done over an entire season. But after trades and roster changes, that record may no longer reflect the team a manager actually has today.

This tool looks at how each team performed before and after a roster event. It compares head-to-head results, performance against every other team (all-play), results against the weekly league median, and scoring averages. The goal is to give a clearer picture of current team performance and roster evolution rather than relying only on season-long standings.

These are observed comparisons, not proof that a trade caused improvement or decline. Small samples, schedules, injuries, and other roster moves all matter.

Data through completed Week 9 · 29 trades · 184 waiver/free-agent acquisitions. New events appear immediately; performance remains pending until a matchup week is completed. NFL absence dates remain provisional. Updated 2026-11-10 15:11 UTC

Sean Johnson True Wins — Schedule Comparisons ⌄

An all-schedules comparison through Week 8: each team's eight weekly scores are tested against all 12 league schedules, producing a total out of 96 possible matchup results.

Original graphic by the credited creator. View original X post ↗

True Wins

Concept via @Johnson_Sean on X ↗

How would each team have performed playing every other team's schedule? Rows are the team whose scores are being tested; columns are the borrowed schedule. Each cell is that team's hypothetical win–loss record against the opponents on the selected schedule.

8 completed weeks · 96 comparisons per team

Method: Compare each team’s weekly score against the opponent on the borrowed schedule. If that opponent would be the team being evaluated, substitute the schedule owner’s weekly score instead. This avoids impossible self-matchups and reproduces Sean’s published Week 1–8 True Wins totals. Week 9 results are included.

BDGE analytics · Static offline build. Future weekly refresh requires recalculating managerial optimal lineups from player-level scores.
